key_findings: Seven differential compounds distinguish raw and wine-processed Evodia rutaecarpa; 7-hydroxycoumarin, chlorogenic acid and limonin inhibit dysmenorrhea uterine smooth muscle cell contraction.
These compounds lowered PGE2, ET-1, P2X3 and Ca2+ and raised NO.
